outline: The course deals with the linear and nonlinear analysis for buckling and initial postbuckling behaviors of compressed structural members. The configurations of overall as well as local buckling are also disscussed. It would help the students to establish the basic concept oncerning structural stability.
schedule:
1st. Week  Introductions
2nd. Week  Methods of analysis
3rd. Week  Buckling of struts, boundary conditions, general solutions
4th. Week  Nonlinearities
5th. Week  Total potential energy, Ritz method
6th. Week  Initial post-buckling behaviors
7th. Week  DEM Models, three distinct points of bifurcation
8th. Week  Buckling of beam- columns, limit points
9th. Week  Buckling of frames
10th. Week  Midterm exam.
11th. Week  Beams on elastic foundations
12th. Week  Buckling of rings, three external pressures
13th. Week  Buckling of confined rings
14th. Week  Buckling of plates
15th. Week  DEM
16th. Week  Chaos
17th. Week  Final reports
18th. Week  Complemetary
assessment:
1. Midterm exam.	  35%
2. Home work	  20%
3. Class attendant  10%
4. Final reports	  35%
